evidence.result: Read the exact assigned Flutter files and existing FEEDBACK_BATCH_20261006 PLAN_RU.md/CHECKPOINT.md/REVIEW.md. The prior plan documents map selection/zoom/search, feedback pause/resume, mobile study tables, and paper contrast as implemented source changes, so none is repeated as a new finding.

findings.consequence: The text says 1/1 or N/N while the bar computes index/length: it is 0% for a one-question quiz and remains below 100% on the last question.
findings.minimal_patch: Compute the displayed-current progress as (journey.index + 1) / attempt.snapshots.length, guarding the nonempty snapshot invariant.
findings.test_proposal: Widget-test a one-question attempt for LinearProgressIndicator.value == 1 and a ten-question attempt at index 9 for value == 1.
findings.trigger: Start a one-question quiz or view the last question of any quiz.

findings.consequence: excludeSemantics hides RadioListTile/CheckboxListTile semantics, then the replacement exposes the opaque stable option id as value and generic button role instead of radio/checkbox checked state.
findings.minimal_patch: Preserve the native tile semantics, or replace the wrapper with explicit checked/inMutuallyExclusive semantics and omit stableId from the announced value.
findings.test_proposal: Use SemanticsTester for a selected radio and selected checkbox; assert the option text and checked/selected state are announced without opt-* IDs.
findings.trigger: Use TalkBack/VoiceOver or keyboard traversal on a single- or multiple-choice option.

findings.consequence: The visible fallback is only a broken-image icon; the localized unavailable text exists only as a semantics label and there is neither visible explanation nor retry. A learner cannot tell whether the image mattered or recover it.
findings.minimal_patch: Render the localized unavailable text beside the icon and provide a retry action that rebuilds the image request; retain the existing fixed placeholder height to avoid layout shift.
findings.test_proposal: Fail an image provider and assert visible unavailable copy plus retry; retry with a succeeding provider and assert the image replaces the fallback.
findings.trigger: A question image has an invalid URL or its network request fails.

findings.consequence: The article silently replaces the illustration with SizedBox.shrink(), removing both the visual teaching cue and any visible/semantic indication that it failed. This defeats the plan's friendly content goal on constrained devices.
findings.minimal_patch: Use a compact error placeholder with the Markdown alt text and localized unavailable copy; keep its bounded height so surrounding content remains stable.
findings.test_proposal: Pump a module with a missing resource image and assert an accessible visible placeholder and retained article/source navigation.
findings.trigger: A resource study image is missing or fails to decode.

findings.consequence: FutureBuilder returns an empty SizedBox for both loading and error. The optional educational path vanishes without a loading or failure state, indistinguishable from a legitimate absence of an article.
findings.minimal_patch: Keep no-link rendering only for a successfully loaded catalog with no match; show a compact nonblocking loading state, and a localized retry/accessibility message for errors.
findings.test_proposal: Inject an AssetBundle that throws, assert a retry/error affordance; inject a delayed successful bundle and assert the link appears after completion while a genuinely missing article remains absent.
findings.trigger: question-articles.json fails to load or decode while a matching question explanation has an article.

remaining_risks: Findings are static source inferences only; narrow viewport layout, assistive-technology announcements, image-network behavior, and actual visual polish require later widget/device/browser validation.
No source file was edited; independent review remains required after an implementation patch.
requirements_compliance: Five source-backed UX issues remain. This audit intentionally excludes the map, two-second feedback timer, study table cards, and study contrast because the feedback checkpoint documents those changes as already implemented.
